text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Gio Nivlhel's Obsidian Palace, an Underground Corridor...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジオ・ニヴルヘル『黒曜宮』、
地下回廊──

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: URYYYYARYAAA!!! HIYORI! BURNING RUSHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うりゃりゃりゃー！！
ヒヨリ
バーニング
ラ～～
ッシュ！！！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...Gyaoooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: How incredibly strong...! So many monsters, and in a mere instant...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
強い……！
あんなたくさんの魔物の群れが、
あっという間に……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: This flow of air... Everyone, stop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──この空気の流れ……
みんな、
止まって。

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: It seems like there was a trap setup in this passage. Beyond this point, space itself is distorted... If we wander in carelessly, we might end up going around in circles forever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら通路に罠がかけられているみたいだ。
この先は、
空間が歪んでいて……
迂闊に迷い込んだら、
永遠に同じ場所を回り続けることになるかもしれない。

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: ...! So it's an "Infinite Corridor"? What should we do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
無限回廊、
ということでしょうか。
どうすれば……

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: Turn back? Maybe?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うかい？
する？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: That'd work, but it'd take us a while. Yui, can you handle this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでもいいけれど、
時間が掛かってしまいそうだね。
ユイ、
いけそう？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text: うんっ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: O'Spirit of Light!
text_block_list.orig_text: 光の精よ──！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Some hours ago.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──少し前。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Pecorine, Kyaru and Kokkoro are seriously injured, as a result {0} and the others are racking their brains over how to capture the Obsidian Palace. At that moment, a certain trio appears at the Giant Whale Castle...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ペコリーヌ、
キャル、
コッコロが深手を負ってしまい
{0}たちは黒曜宮の攻略に頭を悩ませる。
そんな折、
巨鯨城の療養室に現れたのは──

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: The girls of "Twinkle Wish"...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 【トゥインクルウィッシュ】のみなさま……！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Everyone, sorry for the wait! ...I guess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
お待たせ！
……かな？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: My apologies for our tardiness. When we moved from Gio Teogonia to Gio Gehenna through the Gate, we were sent out to the very edges of the world, far away from the Demon's Foot Citadel. There were a lot of powerful monsters there, which gave us a hard time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
遅れてすまない。
ジオ・テオゴニアからジオ・ゲヘナへ移動したとき
鬼岩城塞からとても離れた、
世界の端の端に出てしまってね。
強力な魔物だらけで、
本当にひどい目に遭ったよ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: But, here we are! We've finally caught up~! Wait~
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ようやく追いついたよ～！
って──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Peco-san, Kyaru-chan, Kokkoro-chan! Are you okay?! You all look really pale!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ！
ペコさん、
キャルちゃん、
コッコロちゃん
大丈夫！？
すっごく顔色が悪くなっちゃってるよ！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine in Treatment
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. A lot's happened on our end too, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あはは。
こっちも色々、
あったんですけど──……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...I guess that's about it. It seems like a formidable enemy is waiting for us, and we don't have much time left, so we're in a bit of a pickle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──って感じでさ。
手ごわい敵が待ち構えてそうだし、
時間も余裕ないし、
ちょっと
しんどい状況ー
ってワケ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: So that's what happened...
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Damage that can't be repaired with healing magic... Quite the troublesome opponent you've faced.
text_block_list.orig_text:
回復魔法では治せないダメージか……
ずいぶん厄介な相手だったんだね。

text_block_list.name: Liza
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, okay? Well, we got hurt a lot too, so it's kind of mutual at this point.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさいね？
まぁ
私たちもだいぶ痛めつけられたし、
お互い様ってことで。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: UWAH?! ...Onee-san, you're... a dark elf...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁっ！？
……お姉さん、
ダークエルフ……？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Just now, we were threatened by a headless knight. Then the page had octopus tentacles growing out of her hair. Such a mysterious place just like the other Underworlds. This Gio Nivlhel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきは首無しの騎士にすごまれたし。
給仕の子は髪からタコの足が生えているし。
他の裏世界に負けず劣らず、
不思議な場所だね。
ジオ・ニヴルヘルも。

text_block_list.name: Rurui
text_block_list.text: U-Ujyuru... Pleasedsh to meetsh you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うじゅる……
よろしく
おねがい
しましゅ
でしゅ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Um. From what I recall, you all in Twinkle Wish specialize in clearing places like dungeons, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっと。
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】のみんなは確か、
ダンジョンの攻略とか
得意──
だったわよね？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Eh? W-We do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──えっ？
そ、
そうかな……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! I guess you could call us professional adventurers? So...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ、
そうそう！
あたしたち、
冒険者のプロ？　
だからっ♪

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Geez, don’t get carried away. To be precise, our guild's goal was to adventure and conquer the Tower of Sol, we've just become proficient at pacing ourselves and avoiding traps along the way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
調子に乗らないの。
正確に言うと、
ソルの塔を攻略するために冒険していたら
いつの間にかペース配分とか、
罠の突破が上手くなってただけだから。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In other words, you three are the perfect trio to escort us in our mission. ...However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……成程。
護衛を依頼させていただくには、
うってつけの人材というわけですか。
……しかし……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: It's almost too convenient to believe you just suddenly showed up. With your visible attitudes, you don't seem the kind of people who'd wait to intervene to help your peers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まるで、
計ったみてぇな頃合いの良さじゃあねぇか。
そんだけの気風なら、
首ィ突っ込む機を伺うような
娑婆い真似する奴らにも見えねぇが。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: About that... we received a message in our dreams.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと──
夢で、
お告げがあったんです。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: A dream message? Perhaps it's a message from Lady Ameth...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢のお告げ？
アメスさまの託宣、
でしょうか……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: No, for the phenomenon itself, it did seem like the dreams Fio uses... but the one that appeared was a mischievous fairy, completely different from Fio and Nebbia. She didn't give her name, but she kept saying stuff like: "I'm neutral and equal"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
現象としては
フィオの見せる夢によく似ていた気がするけど……
出てきたのは
フィオやネビアとはまた別の、
悪戯めいた妖精だった。
名乗らなかったけど、
「自分は中立で平等だ」
とか言っていたっけ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: That girl told us the whereabouts of where Kishi-kun was. In a dream where the gardens of the Tower of Sol had been turned upside down...
text_block_list.orig_text:
その子が、
騎士くんたちの居場所を教えてくれたんだ。
ソルの塔のお庭をひっくり返したみたいな夢の中で……

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: It's almost as if someone had come to our rescue. I wonder who that girl is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まるで、
助け舟を出してくださったかのようですね。
いったい、
どなたなのでしょうか……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro & Kyaru
text_block_list.text: ...Phew." "...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: Kyaru? Kokko?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャル？
コッコ？

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: You suddenly collapsed so easily... are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
急に突っ伏しちゃいましたけど……
大丈夫ですかっ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes... The girls from "Twinkle Wish" are the best help we could ask for. I can trust them with the capture and protection in the mission towards the Obsidian Palace with ease.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】のみなさまは、
この上ない助っ人。
黒曜宮の攻略や護衛を、
安心して任せられます。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: And with that being the case, our best course of action here is to get some rest and recover. Isn't that right, Pecorine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならあたしたちは、
とっとと休んで
少しでも回復するのがベストってやつよ。
そうでしょ？　
ペコリーヌ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine in Treatment
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Yui-chan, Rei-san, Hiyori-chan. I'm sorry but... I'll ask you to take care of this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい。
ユイちゃん、
レイさん、
ヒヨリちゃん。
すみませんが、
ここはお願いします。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
任せて！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: O'Spirit of Light!
text_block_list.orig_text: 光の精よ──！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: ...Good. Looks like the traps that generate this "Infinite Corridor" have been cleared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん。
無限回廊の罠は、
解けたみたいだね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: That's my Yui-chan all right♪ Alright, go, go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっすがユイちゃん♪
よーしっ、
ゴーゴー！

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: Amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text: すごい。

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: Yui-san and the others are so cool...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイさんたち、
かっこいい……！

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Truly... The way they're overcoming all those traps while dealing with all those monsters can only be described as brilliant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に……
罠の突破も
魔物への対処も、
鮮やかとしか形容できないほどのお手並みです。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: So this is what a seasoned adventurer looks like... They might be able to handle all of this on their own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが熟練の冒険者……
もう全部彼女たちだけでいけるかもしれませんね。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: ...Princess?

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: ...Those girls in "Twinkle Wish" must have trained a lot to become this powerful and skilled... Even though they're around the same age as I am...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……【トゥインクルウィッシュ】の皆様は、
どれほどの修練の果てに、
あれほどの実力を身につけたのでしょう……
わたくしと変わらない年頃でいらっしゃるのに……

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: ...Furthermore, my personal emotional connection with Kishi-sama... Theirs is much... much stronger than mine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それに。
騎士様との、
心の繋がりも……
あの方々のほうが、
わたくしよりも……
ずっと……

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Hey. Princess. Don't look so damp.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
お姫。
湿気た面してんなよ。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Satsuki...
text_block_list.orig_text: サツキ……

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Satsuki. Those girls from Twinkle Wish seem to be old friends with Kishi-shi, not to add how reliable they are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえ、サツキ。
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】の人たちは
騎士氏の古なじみだけあって、
とても頼りになるようだし──

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: So isn't it okay for you to return home already? I'm sure even you have some injuries from your scuffle with Madam Kokkoro to handle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今からでも、
貴女は帰っていいんじゃないかしら？
コッコロ氏から負った手傷もあるでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: What a pain. Judging by the extent of your injuries, I should be saying that to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
べらんめぇ。
ケガの具合じゃ、
手前の方が余程だろうが。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: There's no chance I'd put the Princess's safety in a currently worn-out ghost like you, Duchess Gre. Never mind the ice dragon brat and the three dark angel ladies, it's practically the first time I've met those pink, blue and yellow girls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなザマのグレ公一人に、
お姫を預けっきりにできっかよ。
氷の竜の嬢ちゃんや
黒い天使の嬢ちゃんたちはともかく、
あのピンクと青と黄色は
初対面も同然だかんな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: And also...
text_block_list.orig_text: それに──

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Princess. I don't know what happened between you and that Little-Kishi, but... stay strong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お姫。
あの騎士公と、
ナニがあったかァ知らねぇが──
しゃんとしな。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: I'm well aware that you're of the kind sort by now. But y'know... that'll get in the way of fighting someone like that lousy Count Orlok or judging misbehaving subjects like us, so don't let it become an hindrance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
手前が優しい
ってのは百も承知だ。
けどな。
オルロックみてぇな手合いが歯向かってきた時や、
俺らを裁く段にあっちゃ、
そいつぁ邪魔だ。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: If you're going to put your head on the line to rule, eating a grudge or two is an everyday occurrence. So when push comes to shove, a Ruler has to punish others. If you don't have that mindset, even with your "Royal's family equipment", you won't go far.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頭を張るなら、
逆恨みを食うなんざ日常茶飯事──
それでも
いざってときゃあ、
他人を吊るさなくちゃなんねぇのが王ってもんだ。
その気構えがなきゃ、
『王家の装備』だって応えちゃくれねぇよ。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'll keep those words in mind... Satsuki.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい。
肝に銘じますわ……
サツキ。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: I think it's our duty to take care of the Princess and overcome all obstacles so she doesn't have to bear that kind of burden.
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫がそんなに背負い込まないよう、
万難を排してお守りするのも
私たちの役目だと思うけれどね。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Geez. You're of the overprotective sort, aren't you, Duchess Gre~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく。
手前はホント過保護だなグレ公──

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it's fine! All of us will protect Violet together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫
だいじょうぶ！
ヴァイオレットさんのことは、
あたしたちも一緒に守るから！

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Lady Hiyori... Thank you so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリ様……
あ
りがとうございます。

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Those ears aren't just for show. You're good, little yellow girl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……耳イイじゃねぇか、
黄色い嬢ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ I may not look it, but I'm TOOOOTALLY focused right now! No matter what comes, I'll be able to react right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ♪
こう見えて今、
とー
っても集中してるから！
何が来ても、
すぐ反応できるようにね！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: ...She's right. She'd be able to handle a surprise attack with ease. I guess the pink and blue over there are the same.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……確かに。
ヌルい打ち込みじゃ、
あっさり避けられる気しかしねぇ。
あっちのピンクと青も
似たようなもんか。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: The "Obsidian Palace"... was it? Although there's a difference since we're going down instead of up, this place feels very similar to the Tower of Sol. Don't you think so too? Yui, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
黒曜宮……
って言ったっけ。
登るか降りるかの違いはあるけど、
ソルの塔と少し雰囲気が似ているね。
そう思わない？　
ユイ、
{0}。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Rei-chan... We can't let our guards down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
レイちゃん。
油断できないね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: It's full of traps, and monsters are powerful. And what's more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
罠だらけだし、
魔物は強力だし。
しかも──

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff sniff*? Something's coming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
なにか。
くるよ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Speak of the devil... Hiyori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ってるそばから、か──
ヒヨリ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Rei-san! I'll do my best to make up for the lack of Peco-san and the others... I'm going to take Violet-san and the others to the deepest part!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
レイさん！
ペコさんたちの分も、
頑張って……
ヴァイオレットさんたちを、
最深部まで
送っちゃうよ！

text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, but I cannot allow that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──悪いが。
そうはいかない。

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: Tentacles...!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 触手っ……！？

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Are those... from back then!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは、
あのときの……！？

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Yes...! They're the same kind as those we encountered on our way to this Gio Nivlhel...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……！
ジオ・ニヴルヘルへ向かう途中に遭遇したものと、
相違ありません……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Everyone, stay back! We'll take care of this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
下がってて！
ここはあたしたちがっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Ehhh!?
text_block_list.orig_text: えーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: They're regenerating quickly, but our attacks do work. Also... I barely perceive any kind of killing intent. A diversion? No, their movements are too erratic for that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
再生は早いが、
攻撃は通じる。
あと──
殺意が薄い。
陽動？　
いや、
それにしては妙な動きだけど……

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: Behind us.
text_block_list.orig_text: うしろ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Eek?! You...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ！？
このっ……！

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: More and more are growing out of both the walls and the floor?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
壁や床のあっちこっちから、
どんどん生えてきますよっ！？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: And what's more... somehow, I can sense some faint magical power coming from those tentacles...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
触手から何か、
魔法の力が……

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: Kishi-sama...!? EEEEK~
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士様っ……！？
き
ゃっ──

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Princess! Kishi-shi...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫！　
騎士氏……！

text_block_list.name: Satsuki
text_block_list.text: Tch...!
text_block_list.orig_text: チッ……！

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Nii-sama, Lady Violet and the others, where did they...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……！？
兄様やヴァイオレット様たちは、
どちらにっ……

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Wha-
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ──

text_block_list.name: Sheffy & Quria
text_block_list.text: Riri-chan!” “Riri-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「リリちゃん！」
「リリさん！」

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: Mm.
text_block_list.orig_text: ん。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: The tentacles are... forming a magic circle...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
触手が、
魔法陣をつくってる……！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Is that magic circle responsible for teleporting everyone around...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの魔法陣でみんな、
空間跳躍させられちゃったの……！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I thought their movements were strange... but their aim is to divide us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしな動きをすると思ったが……
狙いはこちらの分断か！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: The magic circle is going to disappear! Let's chase after it, Yui-chan, Rei-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法陣が消えちゃう！
追いかけよう、
ユイちゃん
レイさん！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Sure... But I believe the place it's going to take us has changed already...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ……
でももう、
行く先が
変えられてるかも……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──待って。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: R-Rei-san...?
text_block_list.orig_text: レイさんっ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: You, in the shadow of that pillar! Come out at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこの柱の影にいる者！
出てこい！

text_block_list.text: ...Excellent~
text_block_list.orig_text: ……素晴らしい──

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: I thought I had concealed my presence with "stealth" and also applied some powerful invisibility magic, but I guess that's no use against you three as a disguise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気配を殺し、
透明化魔法も機能させていたつもりだったが。
君たちにかかっては、
隠れ蓑の代わりにもならないか。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: To control that many tentacles with such precision... And to create a barrier while channeling magical power through it with ease. I thought it would be impossible to do from a distance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれだけの数の触手を、
あれだけ精密に操り……
しかも
結界を作って魔力を通すなんて芸当。
遠くからでは、
とてもじゃないができないと思ってね。

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: I see. A logic expected from one of Twinkle Wish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
成程。
さすがは【トゥインクルウィッシュ】、と言ったところか。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: So you know us?!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしたちをしってるの！？

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Of course I do. It's because you girls are such a troublesome bunch that I decided to take on the role of decoy, knowing that I'd be probably hurt in the process--I owe the Chief a debt of gratitude, after all. ...And what's more...
text_block_list.orig_text:
勿論だとも。
君たちが厄介だからこそ、
少々泥を被るのを覚悟で囮を引き受け──
局長への恩を売ることにしたのさ。
……それに……

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Just how great is the legendary guild that was on the verge of clearing the entire game "formerly" known as the "Legend of Astrum"? As a single "User", that's something I'd love to know and experience for myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『かつての』
レジェンドオブアストルムを
クリア寸前まで進んだ
伝説のギルドが、どれほどのものか。
一ユーザーとしては、
ぜひとも体験しておきたくてね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: ...! This person... does he have his "real" memories...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
この人、
現実の記憶がある……！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: He's from WARLOCK...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ウォーロック……！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: ...Yui, Hiyori. That man is probably capable of competing with the Seven Crowns in power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ユイ、
ヒヨリ。
あの男、
恐らく七冠とも張り合える実力の持ち主だ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the enhancement we received from {0} hasn't stopped. In that case...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
幸い、
{0}からの強化は途切れていない。
ならば……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yep! We'll have to go full power so that we can save everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！
みんなを助けに行くために、
フルパワーだね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Understood!
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かった！

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: Hoo? Then, let me try too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホウ？
では、
こちらも──

text_block_list.name: Grenouille
text_block_list.text: "Change".
text_block_list.orig_text: 『変身』。

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Nii-sama! Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
兄様！
──えっ……？

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: Riri-chan! Wh-Where in the world...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
リリちゃん！
い、
一体
何が……

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: We were. Teleported.
text_block_list.orig_text:
くうかん。
ちょうやく。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It seems that the magic circle created by those tentacles forced us to be the only ones to be transported. But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの触手が作った魔法陣で、
私たちだけ
強制的に
転移させられちゃったみたいね。
でも……

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: This is... we're clearly still inside the Obsidian Palace, aren't we? Then let's hurry and find Onii-san and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここって……
まだ、
黒曜宮の中ですよね。
なら、
急いでお兄さんたちを捜しましょう！

text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, but I can't allow that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──悪いが。
そうもいかない。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: This place is closed for traffic. Turn around from where you came.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここは通行止めだ。
安全な場所に、
早く帰れ。

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: This man... could he be...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この方は、
もしや……！

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: The man covered in full armor... They said he defeated Pecorine-san and Grace-san both...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
完全兜の、
鎧の男──
ペコリーヌさんやグレイスさんを倒したっていう……！

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: He's strong.
text_block_list.orig_text: つよそう。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. In that case, we have to go all out from the start...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうね。
それなら、
全力全開でいかなくっちゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Riri & Quria
text_block_list.text: Yes~!
text_block_list.orig_text: はいっ──！

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: ...I suggest you don't. I'm still not used to this avatar stuff. I don't know if I'll be able to hold back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──やめておけ。
アバターってのには、
まだ慣れていなくてな。
加減ができるかわからんぞ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I don't give a damn about your own situation! I'm just a step away from rescuing my Big Bro and the others... I have to help them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちの事情なんて、
知らないわ！
私たちは、
兄さんたちを助けなくちゃいけないの！

text_block_list.name: Precia
text_block_list.text: Mm.
text_block_list.orig_text: ん。

text_block_list.name: Roland
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Hitting women and children makes my fists weep...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……チッ。
女子供を殴るのは、
拳が痛むってのに──
